prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["While Your Companion Prepares", "Explore basic controls and desktop interaction tips while pet creation finishes in the background.", "Drag pet to move, right-click to hide or adjust settings."]
1: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Choose whether to adopt a pre-made pet companion or craft a custom pet from your own photos."]
2: ["Add Pet Photos for Custom Mascot", "Upload 1 to 3 photos of your pet to generate their desktop companion avatar."]
3: ["Preview Companion Style", "Review your photo selection and avatar preview before finalizing adoption."]
4: ["Signing in ensures your desktop companions remain saved to your account across reinstalls."]
5: ["Generation takes ~2-3 minutes. You can safely minimize this window."]
6: ["Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click your pet to open controls, settings, or hide it."]
7: ["Includes Starter Accessory Bundle"]
8: ["Clear, well-lit photos with face visible produce the best desktop pet renders."]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bundled items
